scenarios.title: Sicilian Tuna Crudo with Olives and Pistachios

lines.line: 1 tablespoon Castelvetrano olives (pitted and finely chopped)
One 8-ounce loin sushi-grade yellowfin tuna, cut into 1/4-inch domino-size slices (about 24 slices)
1 tablespoon brine from capers or caper berries
1 tablespoon chopped jarred hot Italian chiles, such as Victoria
1/3 cup olive oil (quality olive oil like Mina)
3-4 garlic cloves (thinly sliced and pan fried in olive oil )
3 baby gem lettuce (aka little gem lettuce), leaves separated, washed and dried (Note 1)
1 cup cherry tomatoes (, cut in half (or grape tomatoes, or 2 regular tomatoes cut into bite size pieces))
1 cup white bread like baguette (, ciabatta, sourdough, cut into 1cm / 0.4" cubes - preferably stale (Note 3))
Pinch of cooking salt / kosher salt
kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper (to taste)

scenarios.title: Little Gem Wedge Salad with Bacon, Blue Cheese, and Warm Garlic Croutons

lines.line: 1/2 c crumbled blue cheese (plus extra for serving)
3 tbsp chopped chives (plus extra for serving)
salt and freshly cracked black pepper
1/2 cup fresh basil leaves (roughly chopped or torn)

scenarios.title: Pluot-Tomato Salad With Suya Pistachio Crunch

lines.line: ¼ teaspoon ground grains of paradise (see Tip) or black pepper
½ teaspoon kosher salt (such as Diamond Crystal)
¾ teaspoon kosher salt (such as Diamond Crystal)
3 large heirloom tomatoes, cut into pieces
Fresh basil or mint leaves or a combination, torn if large
3 to 4 medium heirloom tomatoes (about 1½ pounds), cut into 1-inch wedges
2 medium nectarines (about 14 ounces), halved and cut into ½-inch wedges
2 medium plums (about 6 ounces), halved and cut into ½-inch wedges
3 tablespoons tamarind concentrate or paste, or 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice, divided
1 chipotle chile in adobo, finely chopped, plus ½ teaspoon adobo sauce
½ small red onion, thinly sliced
¼ cup toasted white sesame seeds
¼ cup loosely packed fresh mint leaves or other soft herbs, torn into pieces
A handful of tortilla chips, for serving
one 14.5-oz. can whole, peeled tomatoes, preferably San Marzano
2 cups (232g) King Arthur ‘00’ Pizza Flour, plus more for dusting
1/8 teaspoon instant yeast or active dry yeast
4 ounces (113g) mozzarella cheese, sliced thinly and torn into 1 1/2" pieces (about 1 cup)
½ teaspoon active dry yeast (or SAF instant yeast)
semolina and all-purpose flour (for dusting the pizza peel)
1 cup pureed or crushed canned San Marzano tomatoes (or canned Italian plum tomatoes)
2-3 fresh garlic cloves (grated with a microplane or pressed)
1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil (plus more for drizzling)
2-3 large pinches of kosher salt (to taste)
¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
2-3 tablespoons finely grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese (plus more for serving)
7 ounces fresh mozzarella cheese (not packed in water) (cut into ½-inch cubes)
5-6 large fresh basil leaves (plus more for garnishing)
2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra to grease pan
1 (28-ounce) can whole peeled tomatoes, drained and hand crushed (recommended: San Marzano)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 recipe fresh pizza dough, recipe follows
1 (8-ounce) ball fresh buffalo mozzarella, water drained
2 cups warm water (100 to 110 degrees F.)
6 cups unbleached all-purpose flour, plus more for dusting
2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for bowl
Optional toppings - fresh dill (fresh parsley, lemon wedges)
¼ teaspoon cracked black pepper (just a pinch if using finely ground black pepper)
1 teaspoon Italian herb seasoning blend (OR herbs de provence, or ¼ teaspoon each dried thyme, parsley, oregano, and basil)
